mainEntity.name: When should I consider hiring a complete remodeling project manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a complete remodeling project manager if your renovation is extensive, involves multiple trades, requires significant design input, or if you have limited time and experience to oversee the project yourself. A project manager is especially beneficial for whole-home remodels, large additions, or complex kitchen and bathroom renovations. They streamline the process, reduce stress, and ensure a professional outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a project manager for extensive renovations, complex projects, or if you lack time and experience to oversee it yourself.
